description: The study treats the collaborating group as a dynamic system whose aggregated state is a three-dimensional vector of the members' heart rates, traced over the exam session.
title: Vector quantization of group physiological data for collaborative-learning state transitions

description: VESCA is a three-phase method for measuring and adjusting examiner-cohort effects in fully nested, multi-circuit OSCEs.
title: VESCA (video-based examiner score comparison and adjustment)
